callees.name: _collect_calls
callees.pre_condition: node is an AST node representing a function body subtree.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of string function names that are called (directly or through attribute access) within the subtree rooted at node. Each element is the syntactic name appearing at the call site.

callees.name: _collect_func_idents
callees.signature: _collect_func_idents(node: ast.FunctionDef | ast.AsyncFunctionDef, source_lines: list[str]) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str]]
callees.pre_condition: node is a function definition AST node with a complete body. source_lines is the full file content as a list of strings, where line N corresponds to index N-1.
callees.post_condition: Returns a triple (idents, body_words, exc_types). idents is the set of lowercase identifier strings that appear as standalone names (Load or Store context) anywhere in the function body. body_words is the set of lowercase alphabetic word tokens extracted from the text of every line spanned by the function body. exc_types is the set of lowercase exception class names referenced in raise statements or except clauses within the function body.

callees.name: _extract_classes
callees.pre_condition: tree is a valid AST module node produced by ast.parse. source_lines is the full file content as a list of strings where line N corresponds to index N-1.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of dicts, one per top-level class definition found in the module. Each dict contains at minimum: 'name' (string, the class identifier), 'docstring' (string, the class docstring or empty string), and 'method_linenos' (list of int start line numbers of methods defined within the class). Returns an empty list when no top-level classes exist.
